# Decision Memory Template

## Decision

[What was chosen?]

## Rationale

[Why was it chosen?]

## Evidence

[Sources, confidence, and limits]

## Assumptions

[What had to be true?]

## Alternatives

[What was not chosen?]

## Tradeoffs

[What was gained, lost, delayed, or made harder?]

## Dissent

[Concerns, minority views, and unresolved questions]

## Owner and timeline

[Responsibility and timing]

## Revision trigger

[What evidence or condition should reopen the decision?]
